_readme: Strike tuning. dur/act are seconds (act = window where the hit lands). reach in pixels, dmg in HP, kb = knockback, stun seconds, hs = hit-stop seconds.

counters._readme: Counter windows in seconds. whipReverse = time to press GRAB after being grabbed for a whip. ropeAttack = time after bouncing off the ropes to press PUNCH (flying clothesline) or KICK/JUMP (dropkick). block: hold away from the opponent to block strikes; chip = share of damage still taken, stun = seconds stuck in the block pose, push = share of the strike's knockback.
